description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)], [Awoken Bestial Power], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Storm Claws] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Awoken Bestial Power
description.text: Celerity and Combat abilities don't consume uses, Celerity and Combat abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Storm Claws after using a Celerity or Combat ability

description.name: Storm Claws
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning]/[Attach Wind] after using three Lightning or Wind abilities if the triggering ability deals Lightning/Wind damage
